jobs.occupation: (Senior) Transaction Analyst Real Estate (m/f/d), Top Tegel (Wertpapieranalyst/in)
jobs.description: We are looking for an (Senior) Analyst to join our Transactions Team in Berlin. In this hands-on investment role, you will support acquisitions, disposals, and joint ventures across office, hotel, residential/BTR, logistics, and development assets. Working closely with Senior Transaction Managers and the Co-Head of Transactions, you will be involved in underwriting, financial modelling, due diligence, transaction execution, and investment analysis across Germany and selected international markets. Location: Berlin Your Tasks Transaction Execution & Management Support the full deal lifecycle on acquisitions and disposals across Germany and international markets, covering office, hotel, residential, logistics, and development assets. Prepare financial models, DCF analyses, and business plans for standing assets and development projects; stress-test assumptions and evaluate investment scenarios. Drafting or assisting with drafting and review Letters of Intent (LOIs), term sheets, and other transaction documents. Coordinate and manage due diligence workstreams, including data room management, adviser coordination, and cross-departmental communication. Support signing and closing management, including CP tracking and condition satisfaction. Investment Analysis & Underwriting Screen, evaluate, and underwrite incoming acquisition opportunities across target asset classes and geographies. Prepare investment memoranda, board presentations, and transaction approval documents that clearly communicate financial metrics, investment thesis, and risk/return profile. Develop and maintain financial models (excel-based) for both stabilised assets and value-add / development opportunities; produce Key Metric Summaries. Conduct in-depth feasibility analysis for repositioning, conversion, and development scenarios. Market Research & Deal Origination Conduct comprehensive market research on target real estate sub-markets, including supply/demand dynamics, rental trends, yield movements, and competitive landscape. Build and maintain deal flow tracking tools and acquisition pipeline databases (CRM). (Support) Deal-sourcing efforts through broker engagement, market intelligence, and investment screening. Participate in meetings with brokers, institutional investors, JV partners, and other stakeholders. Your Profile Education & Experience Degree in Business Administration, Real Estate Management, Finance, Economics, or Engineering; MRICS / master's-level qualification a plus. At least two years of professional experience in real estate investment, private equity (real estate), M&A, asset management, valuation, or brokerage. Track record of financial modelling and investment analysis across European real estate markets; experience with development projects is an advantage. Technical Skills Advanced Excel skills, including dynamic financial models, DCF / IRR analysis, and scenario modelling -- proficiency is non-negotiable. Strong PowerPoint skills; ability to produce clear, concise investment presentations and board materials. Hands-on experience with AI tools (e.g. large language models, AI-assisted research, prompt engineering) and/or CRM / deal management platforms is a strong advantage. Familiarity with data room platforms (e.g. Drooms, Intralinks, Datasite) is a plus. Competencies & Personal Profile Strong quantitative and analytical thinking -- able to cut through complexity and build conviction on investment cases. Self-starter with high initiative, ownership mentality, and the ability to manage multiple work streams simultaneously in a fast-paced deal environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills -- ability to present financial analysis and investment logic concisely to senior stakeholders. Meticulous attention to detail, reliability, and a strong sense of accountability. Collaborative team player with a growth mindset and an appetite for continuous learning. Languages: Excellent English (written and spoken) required; fluent German is a strong plus and highly preferred for the German market. Your Perspective Attractive remuneration package Significant scope for professional development and accelerated career progression within a large, institutionally led real estate platform. Deep cross-asset-class exposure: office, hotel, residential/BTR, retail, and development. Interesting, varied and broad range of tasks in one of the largest real estate companies in Germany and Europe Very good IT infrastructure with access to leading AI tools Good atmosphere, communication culture "on a first-name basis" and a pleasant working atmosphere in an environment with flat hierarchies Individual training for professional and personal development in our academy Professionally equipped, in-house gym with trainers and classes Comprehensive company health management and company pension scheme Mobility and flexibility using pool and company cars for the execution of tasks Exciting virtual programs for childcare with our partner company Voiio Discounts at selected hotels worldwide with up to 30% on overnight stays and special conditions on food and beverages Additional days off on Christmas eve & New years eve Have we sparked your interest?  Then click on "Apply now" and Max Boikov will be happy to receive your application documents, stating your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations. Aroundtown, Personalabteilung, Wittestraße 30, Haus F, 13509 Berlin

jobs.description: Phd Position in Statistics at Ulm University (m/f/d)We seek to increase the proportion of women in research and teaching and particularly encourage qualified female scientists to apply for this position.Severely disabled applicants with equal aptitude will be given preferential consideration.The Institute of Statistics invites applications for a PhD position in mathematical statistics, with a focus on high-dimensional statistics and machine learning. The position is primarily theoretical, with research directions motivated by problems in biomedicine, economics and other life sciences. For more information on the Institute of Statistics, we refer to the webpagehttps://www.uni-ulm.de/mawi/statistics/.Your profile:Applicants should hold a Master's degree (or equivalent) in mathematics, statistics, machine learning or a related mathematically oriented field, with a strong background in mathematical statistics and/or probability. We are looking for candidates with excellent mathematical and analytical skills, a strong interest in theoretical research, good programming skills (e.g. Python or R) and fluency in English.Application:Please send your application tom.vogt@uni-ulm.de. The application deadline is 30 November 2026. Applications received after the deadline may also be considered until the position has been filled. Ifyou have any questions, please contact Michael Vogt (m.vogt@uni-ulm.de). Your application should include a short letter of motivation, a CV, degree certificates and transcripts (Bachelor’s and Master’s), and - where applicable- a list of publications.In addition, you may provide the names and contact details of up to two referees. Please ensure that the referees have consented to the disclosure of theircontact details and to being contacted. Reference letters may be sent directly to the above email address by the application deadline. >Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Kalkulation, Wissenschaftliche Dokumentation, Datenübernahme, Datenaufbereitung, Fachpublikationen erstellen, Wissenschafts-, ForschungsmanagementErweiterte Kenntnisse: Numerische Mathematik, Technische Mathematik, Forschung, Algorithmen, Analysis, Recherche, Informationsbeschaffung, Wirtschaftsmathematik

Was Sie erwartetMöchtest du dazu beitragen, den weltweiten Übergang zur nachhaltigen Energie zu beschleunigen?  Bei Tesla ist das unsere Mission! Wir suchen talentierte Kfz-Techniker*innen für unser Tesla Service Center in Regensburg. Bei Tesla sind unsere Techniker*innen das Rückgrat des Servicebetriebs und unterstützen unsere Mission, den weltweiten Übergang zu nachhaltiger Energie zu beschleunigen. Wir haben eines der innovativsten Fahrzeuge aller Zeiten entwickelt, und als Servicetechniker*in trägst du dazu bei, unserer Kundschaft einen ebenso innovativen Service zu bieten. Wir bieten: Vorsorge- und Zusatzleistungen - Überdurchschnittliches Gehalt - 1. Monatsgehalt - Wahl zwischen Tesla Aktien oder einer Geldprämie   - Mitarbeiteraktienkaufprogramm (Möglichkeit Tesla Aktien zu einem ermäßigten Preis zu erwerben) - Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag - Samstagsarbeitszulage von 25% - Betriebliche Altersvorsorge - Lebensversicherung - Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherung - Unfallversicherung für Geschäftsreisen - Weitere Versicherungsrabatte - Prämien für erfolgreiche Mitarbeiterempfehlungen  Rabatte und Anerkennung - Tesla- und Arbeitskleidung (incl. Laptop für die Arbeit) - Exklusive Firmenvorteile (Corporate Benefits) - Rabatt im Tesla Online-Shop - Upgrade-Möglichkeit auf “Volles Potenzial für autonomes Fahren”  Gesundheit und Wellbeing - Wahl zwischen einer vergünstigten Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft oder einer Wellness Pauschale - 30 Tage Urlaub - Sonderurlaub bei z.B. Umzug, Hochzeit oder Todesfall - Mitarbeiterunterstützungsprogramm “Fürstenberg” (kostenlose, vertrauliche Unterstützung bei persönlichen oder beruflichen Herausforderungen) - Betriebsarzt, Medical Checks und Konsultierungen - Zusätzliches persönliches Arbeitsequipment (z.B. Computerbrille) - Kostenlose Getränke und Obst - Überstundenverpflegung/-mahlzeiten   Mobilität und Transport - Subventioniertes Deutschland-Job-Ticket - Next Bike Mietrabatte - Job Bike Leasing (steuervergünstigt)  Lernen und Entwicklung - Online-Lernplattform - Interne Trainingsprogramme (auch zu Themen wie Hochvoltschulungen und Führungskräftetrainings)  - Einarbeitung in Berlin - Regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche und Leistungsbeurteilungen Was zu tun ist- Service, Reparatur und Verbesserung: Mit Tesla-spezifischer Software und fortschrittlichen Tools führst du Reparaturen und Wartungen an allen Arten von Tesla-Fahrzeugen durch - Qualitätssicherstellung: Wir vertrauen darauf, dass du unsere Fahrzeuge vor der Rückgabe und Vorablieferung sorgfältig prüfst und mit dem höchsten Qualitätsstandards arbeitest- Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest teamübergreifend (lokal und regional), tauschst dich aus und teilst deine Erfahrung, um das Serviceerlebnis weiter zu verbessern- Entwicklung: Bereite dich auf den Erfolg vor. Unsere engagierten internen Schulungsteams schulen dich in Tesla-spezifischer Technologie und der Reparatur von ElektrofahrzeugenWas mitzubringen ist- Technische Erfahrung: Du verfügst über Berufserfahrung in der Durchführung von Fahrzeugservice und Reparaturarbeiten in der Automobil-, Luftfahrt-, Marine- oder ähnlichen Industrien - Technische Qualifizierung: Du verfügst über eine entsprechende Zertifizierung, um in Deutschland Fahrzeugreparaturen durchführen zu können (Ausbildung zum Mechatroniker*in) - Verantwortlichkeit: Du übernimmst eine Vorreiterrolle bei Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsbedenken, die während der Arbeit auftreten - Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Du sprichst und schreibst gut Deutsch und weißt, wie du deinen Standpunkt klar und respektvoll vermitteln kannst - Teamfähigkeit und Flexibilität: Du arbeitest gerne eng mit verschiedenen Menschen zusammen und kannst gute Arbeitsbeziehungen zu allen internen Interessengruppen aufbauen und pflegen. Du kannst im Schichtdienst arbeiten, um dein Team zu unterstützen. Das kann Wochenenden sowie Morgen- und Abendschichten umfassen (bei einer 5-Tage Woche) - Fahrerlaubnis: Du besitzt einen gültigen EU-Führerschein der Klasse B - Berechtigung: Du besitzt eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland ENGLISH VERSIONPlease note that experience or training in the automotive sector is crucial for the recognition of your qualifications. Therefore, while we can initiate the recruiting process immediately, we can only issue a final employment contract once the recognition of your vocational training in Germany is fully completed.Further information can be found at: https://www.anerkennung-in-deutschland.de/html/en/getting-recognition.phpWe are looking for talented Automotive Technicians for Tesla's Service Centers. At Tesla, our Mechanics are the backbone of the Service operation, supporting our mission. We’ve created one of the most innovative vehicles ever made, and as a Service Technician you will help ensure an equally innovative service to our customers.We offer:Provision and Additional Benefits• Above-average salary• 13th-month salary• Choice between Tesla stock or a cash bonus• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (opportunity to purchase Tesla stock at a discounted price)• Permanent employment contract• Saturday work allowance of 25%• Company pension scheme• Life insurance• Occupational disability insurance• Accident insurance for business travel• Further insurance discounts• Bonuses for successful employee referralsDiscounts and Recognition• Tesla apparel and workwear (incl. laptop for work)• Exclusive corporate benefits• Discount in the Tesla Online Shop• Upgrade option to “Full Self-Driving Capability”Health and Wellbeing• Choice between a discounted Urban Sports Club membership or a wellness allowance• 30 days of vacation• Special leave for events such as moving, marriage, or bereavement• Employee Assistance Program “Fürstenberg” (free, confidential support for personal or professional challenges)• Company doctor, medical checks, and consultations• Additional personal work equipment (e.g., computer glasses)• Free drinks and fruit• Overtime meals/cateringMobility and Transport• Subsidized “Deutschland-Job-Ticket”• Next Bike rental discounts• Job Bike leasing (tax-advantaged)Learning and Development• Online learning platform• Internal training programs (including topics such as high-voltage training and leadership training)• Onboarding in Berlin• Regular feedback sessions and performance reviewsWhat You’ll DoYou will- Service, repair and improve: Working with Tesla specific software and advanced tools you will be performing repairs and maintenance on all types of Tesla vehicles, with and without supervision according to skill level- Ensure top quality: Fix it right first time, we trust you to inspect our vehicles diligently before return and pre-delivery and to work with the highest quality standards- Collaborate: Working across teams (local and regional) you will be sharing support and best practices to further improve the service experience- Develop: Setting you up for success, our dedicated in-house training teams will train you on Tesla specific technology and the repair of Electrical VehiclesWhat You’ll Bring- Technically experienced: You have professional experience performing vehicle service and repairs working within either automotive, aviation, marine or similar industries,- Technically qualified: You ideally have relevant certification to perform vehicle repairs. However, this is not a requirement. You will self-manage your technical expertise development,- A good communicator: You speak and write English well and know how to get your point across clearly and respectfully- Safe to drive: We require you to hold a full driver’s license- Flexible: You may work in shifts to support your team, which may include weekends, morning, and evening shifts. You are willing to travel for mobile repairs when needed.Ergänzende Informationen:Nur schwerbehinderte oder ihnen gleichgestellte PersonenAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Kraftfahrzeugelektrik, Kraftfahrzeugelektronik, Kraftfahrzeugwartung, Kraftfahrzeugreparatur, Personenkraftwagentechnik

Why we need youThe HR Business Partner is responsible for supporting our managers with practical, timely people advice, ensuring teams are well supported and set up to perform. This role owns the people agenda for the teams it supports, works closely with People Operations, Talent Acquisition, L&D and Finance, and contributes to improvements in performance management, employee relations and people analytics. Success in this role requires sound judgement, a proactive approach to delivering milestones and consistent delivery aligned with company standards. In the first phase, you will build trusted relationships with your managers, learn our people processes and deliver your first improvements to our performance and workforce planning cycles.Location: Munich, Germany (hybrid, at least 3 days working from the Munich office)What to expect• Own the day-to-day people partnering for your assigned teams, advising managers on hiring, performance, development and team topics• Deliver our performance review and calibration cycles, and coach managers on giving clear feedback• Analyse people data on headcount, attrition and engagement, and propose actions to managers and the leadership team• Support workforce planning with functional leaders and Finance by preparing headcount data and scenarios• Manage employee relations cases with a fair, pragmatic and legally sound approach, escalating complex matters where relevant• Coordinate with employer of record partners to give remote colleagues a consistent and compliant experience• Improve and optimise HR processes and manager toolkits, from onboarding to offboarding• Drive people projects end to end, such as engagement actions or process changes, and propose solutions based on what you learnYour profile in shortRequired qualifications (must have):• Minimum 3 years of experience in an HR Business Partner, HR Generalist or similar HR advisory role• Experience working in a SaaS, tech or fast growing company• Working knowledge of German employment law• Strong communication skills and the ability to advise and influence managers• Demonstrated ability to manage priorities and run projects from start to finish• Comfort with people data and building clear reports• AI savvy: curious and confident using AI tools in your daily work to work faster and smarter, with good judgement on data privacy and quality• Language requirements: business fluent German and English, written and spokenPreferred qualifications (nice to have):• Exposure to organisational change, M&A integration or multi country teams, including employer of record providers• Experience with an HRIS such as Personioand HR platformssuch asLattice• Experience with Jira for tracking and managing work• Hands on experience using Claude or similar AI assistants to support HR work• Knowledge of compensation benchmarking or job levelling• A coaching qualification or systemic HR methodologyWhy you will love MaltegoMaltego is a scale-up company. We provide you the benefits and security of larger corporations, coupled with the dynamic and fast-paced work environment and flat hierarchies of a start-up. We are proud to have a large global community that loves our product because it helps to solve the investigations that are most important. Here are some of the reasons why you will love Maltego:• Make an impact: Work in a scale-up environment with the opportunity to take ownership and make a direct, lasting contribution.• 30 days of paid vacation to relax, recharge, and enjoy life outside of work• Your wellbeing matters: Access mental health support and 1:1 sessions with certified psychologists through Nilo• Keep learning: Maltego supports your development, including subsidies for eligible language courses• Connect beyond the day-to-day: Join company events and celebrations that bring our international community together.• Collaborate with talented and mission-driven teams across the business.At Maltego, we are committed to supporting diversity and inclusion in our organization. We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of race, religion, color, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.LocationBased in our Munich office, with a flexible hybrid working model requiring a minimum of 3 days per week in the office.Required documents / informationReady to help drive the future of digital investigations? Apply now with your resume and a cover letter highlighting your experience!About usMaltego is the all-in-one investigation platform that accelerates complex cyber and OSINT investigations from hours to minutes. The Maltego platform powers preliminary quick OSINT investigations for digital profiling with Maltego Search as well as complex link analysis for large datasets with Maltego Graph. Through Maltego Evidence and Maltego Monitor, the platform enables investigators to collect, monitor, and preserve social media intelligence in real-time for prosecution and public safety. Whether cyber threat intelligence teams or law enforcement, Maltego equips your teams with the most essential and relevant data, with out-of-the-box access to common data sources and over 100 ready-made connectors to more. Mine, merge, and map all your essential intelligence in one place, and uncover hidden truths with Maltego!Learn more about how we can empower your investigations at www.maltego.com.

jobs.description: WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORKWe are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work (https://www.bain.com/about/awards-recognition/) list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor’s list since its founding in 2009. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH Join a group of talent acquisition experts who are the top of their field for attracting and hiring the top of every other field. We manage the full candidate lifecycle and just as Bain is only as good as its people, its people are only as good as our process. If you’re interested in learning how a top management consulting firm creates an impressive candidate experience, this is the team for you.WHAT YOU’LL DO - As Associate, Recruiting (m/f/d), you will support our Intern Hire Team in attracting outstanding talent for consulting internships across our offices in Germany & Austria.- In this role, you will serve as the central point of contact for all candidates throughout the Talent Journey – from the initial contact at a university event through to candidate support during our assessment days.- You will also be responsible for the pre-selection of the most promising candidates for our selection process and will oversee the preparation, execution and follow-up of our assessment days.- You give free rein to your creativity in conceptualizing, planning and executing our campus activities and (flagship) recruiting events, and collaborate with your team colleagues to develop strategies and concepts to further advance our intern hiring.- With your communicative and approachable manner, you also support our internal consultants with all recruiting-related queries.- To make our recruiting success measurable, you regularly prepare analyses along the Talent Journey and present these to your key stakeholders.ABOUT YOU- You have a genuine passion for talent and recruiting.- You leverage your strong communication skills to attract talented individuals to Bain.- You have a strong service orientation and a genuine enthusiasm for daily interaction with candidates and Bainies.- You look forward to taking on responsibility and independently driving topics forward. - You are a resilient and assertive organisational talent who does not shy away from challenges and keeps a cool head under pressure.- You truly thrive in a team setting, built on a foundation of loyalty and reliability.- You are creative, have a sense of humor and impress with a warm and positive presence.YOUR EXPERIENCE- You hold a successfully completed university degree in business administration, social sciences or law, ideally with a focus on human resources management.- You bring initial experience in recruiting and/or campus marketing. - You are proficient in MS Office; initial knowledge of data analytics is an advantage.- Your German and English language skills are excellent, both spoken and writtenWHAT WE OFFER YOUIn addition to an attractive and performance-based remuneration comprising fixed and variable components, you will benefit from numerous additional perks:- Diverse training formats, language courses as well as buddy and mentoring programmes support your personal development- You benefit from the EGYM Wellpass and further offerings for fitness and mental wellbeing- Our mobility concept gives you the flexibility to choose between Mobility Cash, reimbursement of your public transport ticket or JobRad leasing- For us, flexibility means having the best of both worlds: the freedom to work from home and the opportunity to experience genuine team moments in the office – fully in line with our Work@Bain 2.x concept.- With our Community Impact Day and participation in Green Teams, you can make a meaningful difference for society and the environment- Affinity Groups such as Women@Bain promote exchange, networking and career development- Whether Team Retreat, Christmas Party or the „Bain-Wiesn“ – you will experience how fun and team spirit go hand in hand at Bain.- Whether free snacks, beverages or the subsidised catering in our cafeteria (in Munich) – you will find even more at Bain that makes your working day a little bit better.HOW YOU´LL JOIN USHave we sparked your curiosity about an exceptional career with us? We look forward to receiving your complete application (CV, cover letter, certificates, references) via our application portal.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Befragungen (Interviews) durchführen, Datenanalyse, Personalrekrutierung, Messen, Kongresse und Veranstaltungen planen und durchführen, Bewerberauswahl, -beurteilung
